result.brief: 提出开源语音驱动数字人视频生成模型族（2B/21B），用统一 Omni 模型做文本音频条件、三尺度参考视觉记忆与区域自适应人脸损失，并给出 π-Flow 蒸馏加速版本。
result.reason: Speech-driven avatar video generation with reference-aware visual memory and distilled sampling; matches audio-driven video generation direction, though it is generation rather than representation learning.
